questions: When the bottom row is filled and removed, does removal happen at the exact moment the row becomes full, or at the end of the time step after all downward movement for that time step is processed?
Is the bottom row considered filled only when there is a block in every column of that row, or does 'filled' mean no empty cells in that row among all columns?
If a block is in the bottom row and that row is full, is it removed even if it didn't move downward in that step (i.e., it was already in the bottom row at the start of the time step)?
Do blocks move downward simultaneously in a time step, or sequentially in some order (e.g., by row, by column, or by index)?
After a block is removed from the bottom row, can a block from above move into that same column in the bottom row within the same time step?
Are time steps discrete and independent, such that at time t=0 blocks are at initial positions, and at each integer t we apply the full rule set once?
If a block moves downward into a cell that was occupied but whose occupant also moved downward in the same step, is that allowed (i.e., do we check occupancy after all movement)?
For the query, does 'block A_j exists at time T_j' mean at the exact integer time T_j after applying the rules for that time step, or before applying them?
